members.description: The members on this page, in ascending [`NodeId`] order across every family.

start_next_after.description: Cursor (last `node_id`) to pass as `start_after` on the next call, or `None` if this page is empty (treat as end-of-list).

FamilyMemberRecord.description: One entry in a [`FamilyMembersPagedResponse`] page — pairs a node id with its [`FamilyMembership`] record (notably its `joined_at` timestamp).

node_id.description: The node currently in the family.

FamilyMembership.description:
On-chain record of a node's current family membership.

A node belongs to at most one family at a time, so this is keyed by `NodeId` alone — `family_id` is carried in the value to support reverse lookups (all nodes in a given family) via a secondary index.

family_id.description: The family the node is currently a member of.

joined_at.description: Block timestamp (unix seconds) at which the node accepted its invitation and joined the family.
